name: Multiple rounds + expiry — the state engine over time
purpose: Observe more than once (respecting the 15-minute interval), finalize a second round, then record the first result's expiry once its validity lapses.
expected_outcome: Two results under one request; a short first validity yields an EXPIRED transition in the state history; the second round becomes the current state.

create_flow_inputs.step_1_question: Is the documentation site currently serving its status page?
create_flow_inputs.step_8_review_expect: validity of twenty minutes makes expiry observable within one sitting

run_order: Observe as soon as the window opens; finalize after the 300 s delay (round 1 → current).
Wait for the 20-minute validity to lapse: the detail page flags the result as past validity.
Send 'Record expiry': the state history gains an EXPIRED transition.
Observe again (the 15-minute interval has also passed by then) and finalize round 2: the current state returns, with two immutable results recorded.
Close after the window ends and refund the bond.
manual_checks: Observe during the cooldown is disabled with the next possible observation time.
Round numbers increment; earlier rounds remain readable in the results list.
A past-validity result is never presented as current, before and after the expiry act.
Every transition appears, oldest first, in the state history.
